memory_bridge: Use the grass-clearing knife as a clock hand: before noon it marks 午前 with On ゼン, while its physical position ahead of you is 前 with Kun まえ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 午前（ごぜん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Before the knife reaches the top of the clock, hang 午前（ごぜん） over the cleared grass; the word “morning” ends with On ゼン.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 前（まえ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Place the knife one pace ahead and point to the space 前（まえ）, “in front”; the standalone native location word fixes Kun まえ.
